features.name: Grit
features.summary: Begin each day with grit equal to your Wisdom modifier and regain grit by confirming critical hits or dealing killing blows with firearms.

features.name: Deadeye
features.summary: Spend 1 grit per range increment to resolve a firearm attack beyond the first range increment against touch AC.

features.name: Gunslinger's Dodge
features.summary: Spend 1 grit as an immediate action when targeted by a ranged attack to move 5 feet or drop prone and gain an AC bonus.

features.name: Quick Clear
features.summary: Spend 1 grit to remove the broken condition from a misfired firearm, or clear it without spending grit given enough time.

features.name: Gunsmith
features.summary: Gain a battered firearm and Gunsmithing as a bonus feat.

features.name: Gunslinger Initiative
features.summary: While you have grit, gain +2 initiative and draw a firearm as part of the initiative check when your hands are free.

features.name: Pistol-Whip
features.summary: Spend 1 grit to make a melee attack with a firearm, adding its enhancement bonus and potentially knocking the target prone.

features.name: Utility Shot
features.summary: Perform a blast lock, scoot unattended object, or stop bleeding utility shot without spending grit.

features.name: Nimble
features.summary: Gain +1 dodge bonus to AC while wearing light or no armour; increases every 4 levels.

features.name: Bonus Feat
features.summary: Choose a combat or grit feat.

features.name: Gun Training
features.summary: Choose one firearm type; add Dexterity to damage and reduce misfire by 1.

features.name: Dead Shot
features.summary: Spend 1 grit and a full-round action to combine multiple firearm attacks into one devastating hit.

features.name: Startling Shot
features.summary: Deliberately miss while you have grit to render the target flat-footed until the start of its next turn.

features.name: Targeting
features.summary: Spend 1 grit to target arms, head, legs, torso, or wings and impose the location's special effect on a hit.

features.name: Bonus Feat
features.summary: Choose another combat or grit feat.

features.name: Gun Training
features.summary: Choose another firearm type.

features.name: Bleeding Wound
features.summary: Spend 1 grit after a firearm hit to inflict scaling hit-point or ability bleed damage.

features.name: Expert Loading
features.summary: Spend 1 grit when loading a broken firearm to prevent that condition from increasing its misfire value.

features.name: Lightning Reload
features.summary: Reload one barrel as a swift action each round; while you have grit, use the deed without spending grit.

features.name: Bonus Feat
features.summary: Choose another combat or grit feat.

features.name: Gun Training
features.summary: Choose another firearm type.

features.name: Evasive
features.summary: While you have grit, gain evasion, uncanny dodge, and improved uncanny dodge.

features.name: Menacing Shot
features.summary: Spend 1 grit, fire into the air, and make nearby enemies save or become frightened.

features.name: Slinger's Luck
features.summary: Spend grit to reroll a saving throw or skill check, with the cost determined by the roll.

features.name: Bonus Feat
features.summary: Choose another combat or grit feat.

features.name: Gun Training
features.summary: Choose another firearm type.

features.name: Cheat Death
features.summary: Spend all remaining grit, with a minimum of 1, to remain at 1 hit point instead of dying.

features.name: Death's Shot
features.summary: Spend 1 grit before an attack to force a struck target to save or die, with major damage on a successful save.

features.name: Stunning Shot
features.summary: Spend 2 grit before an attack to stagger a struck target, with a save reducing the duration.

features.name: Bonus Feat
features.summary: Choose another combat or grit feat.

features.name: True Grit
features.summary: Choose two deeds and reduce their grit cost by 1, to a minimum of 0.
